programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Duel of the city runabouts: the Audi A1 Quattro versus the Renault Clio RS. Also: the Morgan Plus 8 roadster with its combination of retro design and modern tech. And: the Swiss think-tank Rinspeed's vision of tomorrow's big city traffic.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: A plain, industrial building in the Bavarian town of Regensburg. It's the home of the most innovative German bike workshop: PG Bikes. Regensburg develops and produces electric bikes, with retro-appearance.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Knaus-Tabbert in Jandelsbrunn/Bavaria is one of the leading manufacturers of high-quality caravans and motor homes.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E45 Hot, hotter, hot hatches
programme.desc: Audi introduced their powerful compact car S1 in 2014. In the 1980s, the company already used this model name for their champion car at the Pikes Peak Race. Also: the Mercedes-AMG A 45 vs. the Audi S3. And: Peugeot's compact power pack, the 208 GTI.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E46 Front-wheel driven power models
programme.desc: The Renault Megane R.S. was long regarded as the benchmark among sporty front-wheel driven cars, but the competition doesn't sleep. Peugeot sent their RCZ-R and Seat the Leon Cupra 280 to the race.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We present some of the more extreme specimens in the offroad world: a Fiat Panda monster truck, a Ford Raptor, a conversion of a Mercedes G-class Edition, a modified Volkswagen Touareg, a Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 and the Fiat Panda Cross.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The luxury SUV Infiniti QX70 doesn't need to shy away from a comparison with the Porsche Panamera Turbo S. Also: the unveiling of the Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept in New York. And: test driving the Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI Terrain Tech.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: At the Paris Motor Show 2012 Aston Martin took the opportunity to celebrate the brand's 100th anniversary. Other featured cars included the Maserati GranCabrio, Bentley's GT3, Peugeot's sports car concept Onyx, and McLaren's P1.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S02 : E101 40 Years of BMW M
programme.desc: Several years ago, BMW celebrated the 40th anniversary of their successful M GmbH subsidiary. It all began in 1972 with the introduction of the BMW M1. Still today, the M models are the go-to for car enthusiasts.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Lexus IS-F, Nissan's GTR and Juke R and the Infiniti FX 50 are rather exotic models. Not only the futuristic design but also the performance of these Asian power packs made European car manufacturers quiver in their boots.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: In this episode we invite you to witness the progress of driver Uwe Nittle as he got ready for qualifying at the Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: People called her the "Queen of the Nordschleife" when she used to drive her Porsche or BMW racing cars at the Nürburgring's famous Nordschleife. Sabine Schmitz was a successful racing driver before she took a career turn by working as a TV presenter.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The 1995 Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft was exciting, tough and thrilling, with a strong international competition. Despite this great challenge, Mercedes driver Bernd Schneider dominated the race and won the title.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The year 1952 saw several premieres at the legendary 24-hour endurance race of Le Mans. After 22 years Mercedes-Benz returned to the famous circuit, and Ferrari started to use factory works team cars for the first time.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: S03 : E76 50 years of Opel KAD
programme.desc: The year 1964 marked Opel's foray into the upper class market. The company presented its KAD series with the Kapitän, Admiral and Diplomat models, combining US design with solid German technology.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.sub-title: S03 : E77 Convertibles for a Country Outing
programme.desc: The BMW 507 Roadster was cherished by superstars like Elvis Presley. Today, the 150 HP sports car from 1955 is one of the most valuable classics of all time. Also: following the footsteps of the iconic Porsche brand in a 356 Cabrio.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Topless on the road
programme.desc: Convertibles suggest to the feeling of freedom while driving a car. We took a look at what Opel's Cascada and Adam convertible models had to offer. Also: what does the BMW 3 series Gran Turismo have in common with its bigger brother from the 5 series?

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Pleidelsheim, near Stuttgart. The Mechatronik company specialises in classics from Mercedes. Since 1997, engineers, electricians and mechanics has dedicated itself to the restoration and refinement of classic models.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Machine works Augsburg Nuremberg, Incorporated. MAN, for short. The enterprise has existed for more than 250 years and is among the leading European manufacturers of commercial vehicles, engines and machines.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E41 Charged! Electricity - not fuel
programme.desc: What happens with the range of electric cars if the stereo and heating are in continuous use? We tested Volkswagen's e-up! and Renault's Zoe in every-day situations. Also: the Opel's hybrid model Ampera. And: the BMW i3, the Bavarian electric hatchback.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Some cars' first generation model is so convincing that a second is a no-brainer. We examined the second-generation Nissan Qashqai, Volvo XC70 and Suzuki Sx4 S-Cross in order to see which manufacturers succeeded with their make-over.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We test drove the Rallye Defender and examined how a Jeep Wrangler with only few modifications can double in price. Also: how does the Fiat Panda 4x4 fare in Iceland? Also: Land Rover's Bowler Defender and Volvo's 6-wheeler, the Laplander.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We spent a day in snowy Austria with rally professional Niki Schelle in a Suzuki SX4 S-Cross. Also: why is the Mitsubishi Lancer Evolution perfect for drifting? And: Mercedes and Chrysler present their all-wheel concept cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S01 : E94 Audi at Le Mans
programme.desc: At the 2012 Le Mans 24 Hours, Audi entered the R18 e-tron quattro for the first time. Also: the Porsche Cayenne GTS, the model between the S and the Turbo. And: the Mercedes-Benz CLS Shooting Brake.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Car tuner AC Schnitzer presents its ACS5 Sport model based on the BMW M5. Also: Audi's R8 models Coupe, Spyder and V10 Plus. And: a comparison between four super sports cars.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S01 : E96 Red Bull Show Run
programme.desc: Red Bull takes a Formula One car on a city tour to promote the New Jersey Grand Prix. Also: Bentley proves that a V8 engine can also set elegant accents. And: McLaren presents the MP4-12 C Spider.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: We started a rather unusual race between an S-train and an Audi S3. Also: some of the highlights of the Shanghai Auto Show. And: Mercedes-Benz invested a lot of money in the facelift of their E-Class in order to put their competitors in place.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The RCN Challenge is the ultimate BMW driving experience. We also paid a visit to the Devils Diner, the track's indoor meeting place for drivers.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Prince Leopold von Bayern
programme.desc: Coming from a famous noble family, Prince Leopold of Bavaria started a career as a rally driver in the 1960s before switching to touring cars. He successfully took part in several international races for the Porsche and BMW brands.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1983 Audi introduced the Quattro 4x4 drive to the rally world, adding a new dimension to rally racing. The races became tougher and more brutal. The strain on drivers, vehicles and mechanics alike was extremely intense.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In Europe and Africa in 1984, the rally veterans and drifting artists, Hannu Mikkola, Walter Roehrl, Bjoern Waldegaard, Marku Alen and the rally amazon, Michele Mouton, fought fiercly for the World Championship title.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: Cars like the Ford GT 40, the Jaguar D-Type or the Mercedes 300 SL wrote history on the race track and now break records at auctions. A sumptuously restored 300 SL will start at the most famous classic car rally in the world, the Mille Miglia.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: For more than 20 years the Tuning World Bodensee has been one of the top events in the European car tuning scene. Also: with their i-models BMW started to explore alternative drive technologies. And: taking the Nissan Leaf to Oslo.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: A success story that was made in Germany: The Volkswagen Beetle. No other car has ever moved the masses so much, both in distances, as well as emotions.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: The death rate for motorcycle accidents in Germany has steadily declined, due to the improved quality of safety-helmets. A significant role in these developments has been played by the helmet producer Schuberth.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 More power - less consumption
programme.desc: Chip tuning promises more power with less fuel consumption. We sent two identical BMWs on a road trip in order to see the effects of this manipulation. Also: does the SkyActiv technology improve the Mazda 3's efficiency? And: shock absorbers by Koni.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 The battle - cheap vs. Expensive
programme.desc: The Dacia Logan MCV is a very affordable station wagon. We made a cheap vs. expensive comparison between the Logan and the Golf Variant, the supermini cars Audi A1 quattro and Renault Clio R.S. and the Korean SUVs SsangYong Rexton and Hyundai Santa Fe.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 All-Wheel-Drive on station wagons
programme.desc: The Skoda Octavia, the Opel Insignia Country Tourer, the Subaru Outback, the Audi S4 allroad quattro and the Seat Leon x-perience want to be more than roomy family cars. Their offroad features show that it doesn't always have to be an SUV.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The McLaren MP4-12C isn't just a high-performance sports car, it can also be used as an everyday car - for those who can afford it. In addition: a Rolls Royce Silver Cloud that is covered with Swarowski crystals. Also: the Jaguar XFR and Lotus Evora S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Ferrari cars are legendary. We took a look at this brand's history. In addition: at the Ferrari Challenge, owners get the chance to show off their beloved wheels and let them run. And: the grand tourer Ferrari FF.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The letters AMG sound rather magical in the ears of car enthusiasts. We took a look at some of the company's construction and racing history, their recent creations like the ML 63 SUV, as well as their "Black Series" range of vehicles.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Following the Porsche 911's anniversary we take a look back at this iconic model's history. Also: the world's first series-produced plug-in hybrid with a diesel engine, the Volvo V60. And: safety measures in the car world, from seatbelts to crash tests.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We followed the restoration of the unique Bayer K67 research vehicle, the first all-plastic car in the world, developed in 1967 by the pharmaceutical giant Bayer.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Once again it was time for the VLN Endurance Racing Championship. While the drivers were doing their test laps, we had a look behind the scenes and explored what went on in the pit lanes.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Touring Car Grand Prix Argentina 1964
programme.desc: Tropical temperatures, clouds of dust and breathtaking curves were some of the many challenges for man and machine during the 1964 Touring Car Grand Prix in Argentina. This race took the Mercedes brand to the top of the international racing teams.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The Indy 500 is one of the most spectacular racing events in the world. More than 400.000 spectators watch this mixture of show and motorsports competition at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway each year. We take a look back at the 1994 Indy 500.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the end of the 1960s, under adverse conditions, Heinz Melkus built the GDR's only sports car, the Melkus RS 1000 with lightweight plastic bodywork and gullwing doors. Also: Audi resurrects the Wanderer streamline racing cars.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Volkswagen Samba transforms from pack mule into high-priced classic. And: a former letter box with 37 seats. The 1962 'Graf and Stift' post bus now takes tourists to their hotel.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Audi Sport Quattro S1 was a rally legend. We checked how the company's series vehicle A1 Quattro fares in comparison. Also: the Stuck brothers take the Ford Focus ST to the test track. And: the spacey, but cute electric microcar Renault Twizy.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Behind the scenes of some of the exciting stunts at Action Concept, the biggest action movie production company in Europe. Also: Johannes and Ferdinand Stuck with the BMW Alpina D5 Twin Turbo at the test track. And: the Volkswagen Up city car.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: By putting a lot of thought into their production process BMW drastically reduce their amount of waste. Production in the the Rolls-Royce facility in Goodwood, which also belongs to BMW, is based on the same principles of sustainability and efficiency.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: The German company Kiekert is a supplier for locking systems and the market leader in side door locks. Their products keep cars secure against theft, prevent doors from opening while driving and have a life-saving function in case of an accident.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Wildly through the desert
programme.desc: BMW and the German racing team X-Raid take part in the Dakar Rally with a transformed Mini Countryman. Also: the Mercedes G63 AMG 6x6, a 6-wheel off-road monster. And: the Kia Sportage feels both at home in the rocky terrain of Sicily and the city.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: City-SUVs are the latest trend in the automotive world. The Subaru XV shows its offroad skills, and the Nissan Juke is taken to the race track in Dubai. And: the Mercedes-AMG and the Audi RS Q3 GLA face each other in the mountains.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E33 Sportscars for the Masses
programme.desc: The Ford Mustang has been an icon for decades. What makes this car so special? In addition: the Nissan 370 Z Nismo is half as expensive as a Porsche 911, but its power is on par with the German flagship. And: the 7th generation Volkswagen Golf GTI and R.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E34 The Advantages of All-wheel Drive
programme.desc: We took the all-wheel model of the Mazda CX-5 off the road in order to test its terrain capabilities. In addition: what does the third generation of BMW's so-called SAV X5 have to offer? And: Kia's compact SUV, the Sportage.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Ferrari Four, also called Ferrari FF, is the first four-wheel family car from Maranello. Also: the BMW M5 shines both as a family and business car. And: the Mercedes-Benz SL is a roadster drivers' dream.

programme.desc: Despite its size the Audi A1 MTM is a real high speed monster. Also: the Bugatti Galibier is one of the fastest sedans in the world. And: only 77 units worldwide, the exclusive Aston Martin One-77.

programme.desc: The death rate for motorcycle accidents in Germany has steadily declined, due to the improved quality of safety-helmets. A significant role in these developments has been played by the helmet producer Schuberth.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E43 More power - less consumption
programme.desc: Chip tuning promises more power with less fuel consumption. We sent two identical BMWs on a road trip in order to see the effects of this manipulation. Also: does the SkyActiv technology improve the Mazda 3's efficiency? And: shock absorbers by Koni.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E44 The battle - cheap vs. Expensive
programme.desc: The Dacia Logan MCV is a very affordable station wagon. We made a cheap vs. expensive comparison between the Logan and the Golf Variant, the supermini cars Audi A1 quattro and Renault Clio R.S. and the Korean SUVs SsangYong Rexton and Hyundai Santa Fe.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We show how to have a lot of fun on gravel roads in a Subaru WRX STI. Also: in the 1990s, Ford had a successful go at rally competitions with the Ford Escort RS Cosworth. And: the Volkswagen Polo WRC shows its 4x4 skills.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: S01 : E29 All-Wheel-Drive on station wagons
programme.desc: The Skoda Octavia, the Opel Insignia Country Tourer, the Subaru Outback, the Audi S4 allroad quattro and the Seat Leon x-perience want to be more than roomy family cars. Their offroad features show that it doesn't always have to be an SUV.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The McLaren MP4-12C isn't just a high-performance sports car, it can also be used as an everyday car - for those who can afford it. In addition: a Rolls Royce Silver Cloud that is covered with Swarowski crystals. Also: the Jaguar XFR and Lotus Evora S.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Ferrari cars are legendary. We took a look at this brand's history. In addition: at the Ferrari Challenge, owners get the chance to show off their beloved wheels and let them run. And: the grand tourer Ferrari FF.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The letters AMG sound rather magical in the ears of car enthusiasts. We took a look at some of the company's construction and racing history, their recent creations like the ML 63 SUV, as well as their "Black Series" range of vehicles.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Following the Porsche 911's anniversary we take a look back at this iconic model's history. Also: the world's first series-produced plug-in hybrid with a diesel engine, the Volvo V60. And: safety measures in the car world, from seatbelts to crash tests.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We followed the restoration of the unique Bayer K67 research vehicle, the first all-plastic car in the world, developed in 1967 by the pharmaceutical giant Bayer.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: The roaring sounds of engines and exhausts usually dominate the Nuerburgring, but we focused on something a bit quieter this time. How about taking part in a 15 mile bike ride around the ring, or perhaps a 16 mile run?

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: In 1997, after the hot dusty plains of Africa the WRC series returned to Europe for the fourth round, the first real gravel race of the year. Based in the seaside resort of Figueira da Foz the rally featured some of Portugal's most picturesque locations.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: The 1997 Rally Argentina took the drivers and teams to the dusty winding roads of the Andes Mountains in the province of Cordoba. Over the course of 3 days spectators on horseback or on foot watched the 23 stages of the race with excitement.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The IAA in Frankfurt, Germany, is the most important car show in the world. Manufacturers from all over the world present their newest models and their take on alternative drives and new technologies. We took a look at the 2013 show's highlights.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Kempten in Allgau. The ABT Sportsline company with ? 115 year tradition resides at the foot of the Alps. ABT Sportsline is the largest Volkswagen group-tuning company in the world and works closely with Audi.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Artega - the name, which raises the spirits of German automotive lovers. The beautifully designed mid-engine sports car from the East-Westphalian province, is an eye-catcher. The Artega is a rare-looking species.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E47 Close to the ground
programme.desc: In their 4 series BMW took into account that sporty vehicles need a low center of gravity. In the manufacturer's range of vehicles this model is closest to the asphalt. We compared the BMW 435i and Porsche's Cayman S and took a look at the Alfa Romeo 4C.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E49 Athletes on stilts - Power SUVs
programme.desc: Since the rising popularity of SUVs compact models have become a new trend, so the manufacturers started offering more models and pushing their performance. We took a look at the competitors Audi RS Q3, Mercedes-AMG GLA 45 and Porsche Macan Turbo.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Four elements, four 4x4's. The Audi Q3 feels at home on city streets and gravel roads, the Nissan Qashqai defeats the wind, the Porsche Macan Turbo clashes with the desert heat, and the amphibian car Volkswagen Schwimmwagen crosses the Danube river.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: In Europe pickups are mainly used commercially. In the US these trucks are as common as SUVs. We compared the Volkswagen Amarok to the Toyota Hilux. Also: current US pickups, the Chevrolet Colorado and GMC's Sierra and Canyon.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Sant'Agata Bolognese, the home of the iconic Italian sports car manufacturer Lamborghini, is the perfect place to take a look under the hood of the different Gallardo models. Also: cruising through Rome in an Aventador LP700-4.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Racing driver Patrick Simon presents a few of his personal highlights, like the Ferrari FF, McLaren's British super car MP4 12C, the Lamborghinis Gallardo Performante and Superleggera and the versatile Lexus IS-F.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S02 : E106 Porsche to the Max
programme.desc: The Techart Grand GT by Porsche's house tuner is a souped-up Panamera. But the off-the-shelf GTS model also has its treats. Patrick Simon took this monster to the track. In addition: Ruf's anniversary model RT 35. And: the 911 Carrera 4.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: At the old-timer grand prix at the Nuerburgring you for example can see the Mercedes S with 160 horsepower that lead Rudolf Caracciola to victory in the 1927 opening race.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Since 1967 the Canadian American Challenge Cup Series for Group 7 cars had been dominated by the orange machines of the McLaren team. In 1972 however, the Porsche 917/10 appeared, posing a definite threat to the McLaren supremacy.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 The Golden Age of Rally Sports
programme.desc: The late 1950s saw the dawn of the Golden Age of rally motorsports. Rally racing became a professional sport and the automotive industry began to build tougher cars, whereas drivers started to specialize in competitive motorsports.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: As an homage to driving top-down we took a look at three of the most beautiful convertibles. The animalistic sound of the Audi S3 convertible's 4-cylinder is astonishing. But what about the Nissan 370 Z Roadster? Or Porsche's Boxster GTS?

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Mercedes-AMG E63 S is a wolf in sheep's clothing. This station wagon has more power than the Nissan GTR 'Godzilla'. Also: the Porsche Panamera GTS feels at home on the motorway and on the race track. And: Audi's powerful all-purpose executive car RS6.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: To sports car fans the name Pagani is connected with the manufacturer's thunderous 12-cylinder high-performance engine. Their Huayra model isn't comparable to any other sports car, it’s one of the most exclusive cars available.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: With the A8, Audi didn't exactly follow the concept of downsizing. Same goes for the large executive cars by BMW, like the 750i. And it was the same song and dance with Volkswagen, who developed the luxury version of their Phaeton.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The elegance of an Aston Martin Vanquish met the brute force of a Lamborghini Veneno at the 2013 Geneva Motor Show. There is one thing that united all the super cars at this international event: exclusivity.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Stunt world champion Chris Pfeiffer test drives the BMW F 800 R and explains why he is rather excited about the performance and handling of this robust and agile roadster. Also: a look behind the scenes of German helmet manufacturer Schuberth Helme's testing and development procedures. And: German actor Jürgen Vogel puts his new Ducati 1198 SP to the test at the Nürburgring.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.sub-title: S01 : E32 Stereotypes on Two Wheels
programme.desc: Scooters, stereotypes on two wheels? It doesn't always have to be a classic Vespa! We take a look at three alternatives: Kymco's big scooter xciting 500 i that feels like riding on a sofa, Piaggio's three-wheeler MP3 500 with two front wheels that promises more dynamic driving pleasure and the powerful electric scooter e-max from China.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 Triumph Speed Triple Carbon
programme.desc: Suzuki's all-rounder flagship, the V-Strom, underwent a rejuvenation treatment. Will the new V-Strom 650 be able to surpass its versatile predecessors? Also: does the use of carbon make sense in the manufacturing of motorcycles? And: a bike tour on the Deutsche Alpenstraße, the German Alpine Road, in the footsteps of Bavaria's fairy tale king Ludwig II.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: The big KTM 990 Adventure is Austria’s answer to BMW's bestselling R 1200 GS. Is KTM's allrounder for streets, gravel roads and long distance travels a worthy opponent for the dominating Bavarian bike? Also: travel enduros are put to the test as we accompany two German adventurers on their 31-day, 5800-kilometre bike tour through Thailand, Laos and Cambodia.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: Alois Ruf is the founder of a small, but well-known car manufacturing company in Bavaria that specialises in building their own vision of street legal super sports cars on the foundation of Porsche bodys.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Prince Leopold von Bayern
programme.desc: Coming from a famous noble family, Prince Leopold of Bavaria started a career as a rally driver in the 1960s before switching to touring cars. He successfully took part in several international races for the Porsche and BMW brands.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The Melkus RS 1000 is considered the Ferrari of the East. The extremely flat two-seater with its mid-engine and gullwing doors was the only real sports car ever built in the GDR and is hardly known outside the former country's borders.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: We accompanied former professional rally driver and European Rally Cross Champion Herbert Gruensteidl when he participated in the Historic Ice Trophy in Austria with an original car rebuilt in 2002 by BMW tuner Schnitzer.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The top-of-the-line specimens of a car model range are built for pure driving pleasure. We put the VW Golf R, the Audi TTS and the BMW M 235i to the test in order to see if they are worthy of bearing the crown of their model range.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Not only in the big cities it's a growing struggle for parking spots. . We took the BMW X6, the Citroen Cactus and the Smart forfour to town in order to find out how these cars would cope in this situation and surrounding.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S03 : E61 Driving pleasure in winter
programme.desc: Slippery or muddy roads and bad visibility are circumstances that often spoil driving pleasure in winter. We took two almost identical Porsche 911's to an icy test track. Also: drifting fun in the snow with the Suzuki SX4 S-Cross.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: After the 24-hour race was over we left the Nuerburgring and moved to Büren, Germany, where the Raeder Motorsport company is based. They are famous for front-wheel drives with a great performance that put a lot of horsepower to the track.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In the early 20th century, automotive pioneer Henry Ford revolutionized the world of car manufacturing with the foundation of the Ford Motor Company and his introduction of the assembly line technique in his factory and the iconic Model T.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Extreme heat and treacherous water hazards weren't the only challenges that the amateur drivers at the Rally Munich-Marrakesh in 1990 had to face. This endeavour over more than 3,000 kilometres demanded everything from all the participants.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: 1990 was an extremely thrilling year at the Porsche Carrera Cup, the fastest and most exciting one-make racing event. Porsche started with the new Carrera 2 Cup Coupe with 265hp generated by a powerful 6-cylinder engine.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: At the 2014 Saalbach Classic rally 80 teams raced their automobile rarities through the Austrian Alps. In addition: rally legend Walter Röhrl in a Porsche 911 RSR at the Cologne-Ahrweiler rally. And: the infamous Group B vehicle category.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: The Ford Focus ST 5 Turnier and the Volvo V40 T5 R-Design in our comparison. Also: we put Mercedes-Benz' S-Class to the test. And: the Ariel Atom, ultimate accelleration and maximum corner speed in a car reduced to the bare minimum.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Duel of the city runabouts: the Audi A1 Quattro versus the Renault Clio RS. Also: the Morgan Plus 8 roadster with its combination of retro design and modern tech. And: the Swiss think-tank Rinspeed's vision of tomorrow's big city traffic.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: A plain, industrial building in the Bavarian town of Regensburg. It's the home of the most innovative German bike workshop: PG Bikes. Regensburg develops and produces electric bikes, with retro-appearance.

programme.title: Made in ...
programme.desc: Knaus-Tabbert in Jandelsbrunn/Bavaria is one of the leading manufacturers of high-quality caravans and motor homes.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E45 Hot, hotter, hot hatches
programme.desc: Audi introduced their powerful compact car S1 in 2014. In the 1980s, the company already used this model name for their champion car at the Pikes Peak Race. Also: the Mercedes-AMG A 45 vs. the Audi S3. And: Peugeot's compact power pack, the 208 GTI.

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.sub-title: S02 : E46 Front-wheel driven power models
programme.desc: The Renault Megane R.S. was long regarded as the benchmark among sporty front-wheel driven cars, but the competition doesn't sleep. Peugeot sent their RCZ-R and Seat the Leon Cupra 280 to the race.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: We present some of the more extreme specimens in the offroad world: a Fiat Panda monster truck, a Ford Raptor, a conversion of a Mercedes G-class Edition, a modified Volkswagen Touareg, a Jeep Grand Cherokee SRT8 and the Fiat Panda Cross.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: The luxury SUV Infiniti QX70 doesn't need to shy away from a comparison with the Porsche Panamera Turbo S. Also: the unveiling of the Land Rover Discovery Vision Concept in New York. And: test driving the Volkswagen Touareg V6 TDI Terrain Tech.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: At the Paris Motor Show 2012 Aston Martin took the opportunity to celebrate the brand's 100th anniversary. Other featured cars included the Maserati GranCabrio, Bentley's GT3, Peugeot's sports car concept Onyx, and McLaren's P1.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.sub-title: S02 : E101 40 Years of BMW M
programme.desc: Several years ago, BMW celebrated the 40th anniversary of their successful M GmbH subsidiary. It all began in 1972 with the introduction of the BMW M1. Still today, the M models are the go-to for car enthusiasts.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: The Lexus IS-F, Nissan's GTR and Juke R and the Infiniti FX 50 are rather exotic models. Not only the futuristic design but also the performance of these Asian power packs made European car manufacturers quiver in their boots.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: At the old-timer grand prix at the Nuerburgring you for example can see the Mercedes S with 160 horsepower that lead Rudolf Caracciola to victory in the 1927 opening race.

programme.title: Classic Races
programme.desc: Since 1967 the Canadian American Challenge Cup Series for Group 7 cars had been dominated by the orange machines of the McLaren team. In 1972 however, the Porsche 917/10 appeared, posing a definite threat to the McLaren supremacy.

programme.sub-title: S2026 : E12 CRAZY Big Air Moments Fans Can’t Stop Thinking About
programme.desc: Feel the roar of the engines in Las Vegas as the World Finals reach a fever pitch during an unforgettable freestyle session. Dennis Anderson sets a punishing pace, driving on the "ragged edge" with relentless intensity , while Todd LeDuc risks it all in Metal Militia with massive air and back-to-back backflips. From the high-stakes pressure of "bonus time" maneuvers to the incredible "wow factor" of four-second hang times, this competition demonstrates exactly what championships are made of.

programme.title: Best of Monster Jam
programme.sub-title: S2026 : E03 Legendary Stadium Runs Compilation
programme.desc: Step into the high-stakes world of stadium competition where the obstacles are larger than life and the rivalries are legendary. Watch as a teenage Ryan Anderson, the reigning Rookie of the Year, attempts to carve his own legacy in the "big field" with a fearless driving style that pushes his truck to the absolute limit. The intensity reaches a fever pitch when nine-time world champion Tom Meents brings Maximum Destruction to the track, battling mechanical failures and tire damage to deliver a performance only a veteran can provide. From technical saves and massive air to the relentless pursuit of the Freestyle lead, this episode captures the raw power and "blood rhythm" of drivers who refuse to cut back for their fans.

programme.title: Dobrze Jest Ufać... Ale Lepiej Strzelać

programme.title: Ścigany

programme.title: Zimny Zabójca
programme.desc: José Desman zabija swojego pracodawcę, pana Salazara, byłego sędziego, który skazał jego ojca na śmierć.

programme.title: Dorwać Chaco
programme.desc: Chaco to Meksykanin, który zdaje się uciekać przed każdym. Zostaje oskarżony o morderstwo paru bydlaków.

programme.title: Zwali go King
programme.desc: Łowca nagród tropi bezwzględny gang handlarzy bronią przez granicę z Meksykiem.

programme.desc: Po trzech latach katorgi w pustynnym więzieniu były szeryf Ted Barnett ucieka, by odnaleźć trzech mężczyzn, którzy wrobili go w zabójstwo ojca i skazali na wieloletnie roboty. Rozpoczyna samotne polowanie, by odkryć prawdę i oczyścić swoje imię.

programme.title: McLintock!
programme.desc: George Washington McLintock, potężny baron bydła, staje między rodzinnymi konfliktami a społecznymi napięciami na pograniczu. Powrót żony i córki komplikuje jego życie, gdy próbuje zachować pokój między osadnikami, Indianami i skorumpowanymi urzędnikami. Western o honorze, miłości i godności.

programme.title: Znajdź Miejsce W Którym Możesz Umrzeć
programme.desc: Wyrzutek, żołnierz Konfederacji, odkupuje swoje winy broniąc kobiety przed bandytami, którzy są gotowi ją zabić dla kopalni złota.

programme.title: Rewolwerowiec z Jalisco
programme.desc: Salvador kocha się w pięknej Marii, niestety jej ojciec nie akceptuje ich związku.

programme.title: Z Bogiem, Gringo
programme.desc: Bracia Cris wrobili Gringo w zabójstwo jego brata, przez co trafia do więzienia z przyjacielem. Gdy prawdziwi mordercy uciekają i porywają Carmen, Gringo rusza w pełne niebezpieczeństw przygody, by oczyścić swoje imię i ocalić ukochaną.

programme.title: Cjamango - Krzyże na krwawym piasku
programme.desc: Kiedy Cjamango wygrywa w pokera worek złota, gangi El Tigre i Don Pablo atakują go. Podczas leczenia ran, Cjamango zaprzyjaźnia się z meksykańskim chłopcem Manuelem i piękną dziewczyną, Perlą.

programme.title: Gang Doolina
programme.desc: Po śmierci Daltonów Bill Doolin ucieka, staje się przywódcą własnego gangu, a później próbuje zacząć od nowa pod innym nazwiskiem. Gdy jego przeszłość wychodzi na jaw, znów musi uciekać jako poszukiwany banita.

programme.title: Ogród zła
programme.desc: Trzech Amerykanów otrzymuje propozycję: za 2000 dolarów mają uratować męża kobiety uwięzionego w kopalni złota w górach Meksyku. W trakcie podróży każdy z nich kalkuluje szanse na zdobycie kobiety lub kopalni, o ile przeżyją tę niebezpieczną misję.

programme.title: Dni Przemocy
programme.desc: W ostatnich miesiącach wojny secesyjnej brat Joego zostaje niesprawiedliwie zabity przez Clifforda, kapitana armii północnej. Joe postanawia dołączyć do grupy południowców zdeterminowanych, by stawiać opór do końca.

programme.title: Ramon - Meksykanin
programme.desc: Esmerelda zostaje zaatakowana, a jej brat Juan Morales ginie, co wywołuje konflikt rodzinny. Bandziory pod wodzą Ramona Morales napadają na ranczo, zabijając ojca i porywając Esmereldę. Slim Baxter mimo próśb matki podejmuje walkę o zemstę i sprawiedliwość.

programme.title: Kula Dla Generała
programme.desc: Banda meksykańskich handlarzy bronią, zatrudnionych przez rewolucyjnego generała, przyjmuje do swojego gangu Amerykanina, nie wiedząc o jego intencjach.

programme.title: Łowcy kłopotów
programme.desc: Dwaj skłóceni bracia, którzy nie rozmawiają ze sobą, postanawiają spędzić Boże Narodzenie z matką. Kobieta, mająca nadzieję na ich pojednanie, stara się połączyć rodzinę w ten wyjątkowy czas. Choć ich spotkanie nie jest łatwe, matka nie rezygnuje z próby przywrócenia harmonii i miłości w rodzinie.

programme.title: Kid, Postrach Zachodu
programme.desc: Andrea Balestri jako Kid Terror O'Hara, przywódca grupy dzieci, które w opuszczonym miasteczku Torque, bawią się w kowbojskie życie.

programme.title: Zabójcy z Dakoty
programme.desc: Ranczer Ed Sampson chce pozbyć się osadników i zleca podpalenie domu Martinów. Ginie ojciec, a syn Joe trafia na drogę zemsty. Emerytowany rewolwerowiec Ned East ratuje go przed prowokacją Beckera. Sampson zatrudnia Clinta Jonesa do zastraszania Squattersów, lecz ten ratując narzeczone z napadu, sam zaczyna pożądać wybranki Joe.

programme.title: Czterej Zabójcy Sartany
programme.desc: Siedmiu zamaskowanych bandytów porywa młodą Susy, kuzynkę burmistrza Clayton City, Franka Clonny'ego. Frank przyjmuje 15.000 dolarów okupu, którego żądają bandyci i obmyśla plan, który pozwoli mu odzyskać pieniądze i schwytać bandytów.

programme.title: Anioł zemsty
programme.desc: Miles Utley, a professional Mormon commando and bodyguard, is forced to leave his faith and question his beliefs while investigating a scandal involving murder and land speculation, uncovering secrets that challenge everything he once trusted.

programme.title: Doktor Złote Ręce
programme.desc: Były chirurg Doc McGregor jest teraz karciarzem. Zostaje niesłusznie oskarżony o morderstwo i ścigany przez Slade'a, łowcę nagród.

programme.title: Trinity w Eldorado
programme.desc: Po kilku nieudanych próbach oszustwa, Książę Jonatan III i jego wspólnik Sebastian Carter łączą siły z Ringo i jego gangiem, by okraść Meksykanina Eldorado.

programme.title: Apache Rose
programme.desc: Roy jest poszukiwaczem ropy naftowej. Stara się uzyskać prawa do odwiertów na starej hiszpańskiej hacjendzie. Roy wpada w konflikt z szajką hazardzistów z pływającego kasyna, którzy są zdeterminowani, by przejąć hacjendę.

programme.title: Kasztanek
programme.desc: Chłopiec z rancza dostaje kucyka. Chłopiec go kocha, ale ten ucieka. Zaczyna się niespodziewana i tragiczna w skutkach historia.

programme.title: Spóźniona zemsta
programme.desc: Chłopiec z Dzikiego Zachodu, nawiedzany wspomnieniami masakry rodziny, dorasta z pragnieniem zemsty. Zakochuje się w przybranej siostrze, walczy z zakazanym uczuciem, wrogością brata i groźbą śmierci ze strony członka rodziny.

programme.title: Buckaroo - Winchester Nie Wybacza
programme.desc: Gdy dyliżans, którym podróżuje niejaki Lash, zostaje zaatakowany przez gang Monteiro, Lash zabija jadącego z nim przyjaciela i wspólnika. Dlaczego? Żeby zabezpieczyć swoje bogactwo...

programme.title: Zemsta Ringo
programme.desc: Dwóch poszukiwaczy przygód ratuje życie mężczyzny, który ma na plecach wytatuowaną mapę skarbów. Druga potrzebna mapa znajduje się na plecach szeryfa. Zaczyna się polowanie.

programme.title: Podróż do Tomahawk
programme.desc: W 1876 roku Dawson próbuje zatrzymać pociąg przed dotarciem do Tomahawk w Kolorado, by chronić swój biznes dyliżansów. Kit musi doprowadzić skład do celu i zabiera na pokład Johnny’ego jako pasażera. Wraz z tancerkami Madame Adelaide podróż zamienia się w muzyczną i pełną przygód wyprawę.

programme.title: Ujeżdżanie Barbie
programme.desc: Nieudana tinderowa randka kończy się tym, że fitnessowa influencerka Barbie gubi się w dziczy. Barbie walczy o przetrwanie, a przy okazji jest świadkiem działań Departamentu Bezpieczeństwa Krajowego i ataku kosmitów. Na domiar złego nie ma zasięgu i nie może wrzucić swoich selfie do sieci.

programme.title: Piraci z wybrzeża
programme.desc: Wspaniała, barwna włoska epopeja kostiumowa z Barkerem w roli kapitana statku, który musi zmierzyć się z przebiegłymi piratami. Film ma kilka interesujących zwrotów akcji i mnóstwo niespodziewanych wątków.

programme.title: Miłosne Chwyty

programme.title: Młody Disney
programme.desc: Film oparty na książce „Walt przed Mikim”. Przedstawia wczesne lata kariery Walta Disneya.

programme.title: Krokodyl i hipopotam
programme.desc: W Afryce Slim i Tom stają naprzeciw niemieckiego tyrana, który wyprzedaje dzikie zwierzęta do zagranicznych zoo. Oburzeni bohaterowie ruszają do akcji, by powstrzymać jego proceder. Czeka ich pełna bójek i pościgów konfrontacja z jego bezwzględnym gangiem.

programme.title: Kapitan Battle
programme.desc: Sam Battle podąża śladami swojego pradziadka, super bohatera z II wojny światowej znanego jako CAPTAIN BATTLE, przyjmując eksperymentalny lek podczas pobytu w wojsku.

programme.title: Ekipa Ratunkowa Ameryki
programme.desc: Grupa tajemniczych złoczyńców znanych jako "The Alliance" zastawia pułapkę na Podatnika. Więżą go, torturują i snują plany publicznego ukrzyżowania.

programme.title: Znawca sztuki
programme.desc: Rodzeństwo Ken i Alice zostają wplątani w konflikt z przestępcami z Seattle, którzy chcą wykorzystać ich talent jako artystów sztuk walki.

programme.title: Buntownik z Mafii
programme.desc: Przez śmiertelną pomyłkę mafijny najemnik rozpoczyna brutalną krucjatę przeciwko swojemu szefowi, jednocześnie mierząc się ze swoją przeszłością.

programme.title: Astronauta - Ostatnia Próba
programme.desc: Kiedy tragiczny wypadek niweczy pierwszą załogową misję mającą na celu zbadanie życia na księżycach Jowisza, Michael Forrest musi odbyć 3-letnią podróż do domu na Ziemię całkowicie sam.

programme.title: Wielka Stopa
programme.desc: Pewna rodzina wprowadza się do domku na odludziu tylko po to, by dać się sterroryzować dziwnemu, przerażającemu stworzeniu z lasu.

programme.title: Inne Słońce
programme.desc: Po przeprowadzce z Szanghaju do Niemiec chińska rodzina zmaga się z aklimatyzacją w nowej kulturze.

programme.title: Check Point
programme.desc: Port City w Północnej Karolinie: Podczas rutynowego biwaku miejscowy włóczęga, który był dawnym żołnierzem piechoty morskiej, natrafia na plany inwazji na Amerykę

programme.title: Miłość na widelcu
programme.desc: Alice, utalentowana sous-chef z Nowego Jorku, zostaje jurorką prestiżowego konkursu kulinarnego w Kansas City. Wbrew niezadowoleniu swojego chłopaka i szefa Bretta, jedzie na wydarzenie, gdzie spotyka byłego z czasów studiów, Christiana. To spotkanie i konkurs skłaniają ją do ponownego przemyślenia swoich marzeń.

programme.title: Zakochana Shirin
programme.desc: Miłość nie zna granic i takie jest założenie uroczej, irańsko-amerykańskiej komedii romantycznej "Zakochana Shirin".

programme.title: Ścigając Roberta Barkera
programme.desc: Fotograf- paparazzi zostaje wplątany w sfabrykowaną historię tabloidu, która ma na celu doprowadzenie do upadku znanego aktora.

programme.title: Obietnice
programme.desc: Dwójka dzieci traci ze sobą kontakt, gdy jedno z nich wyjeżdża do innego miasta. Po latach znów się połączą, nie zdając sobie z tego sprawy. Kiedy uświadomią sobie kim są, będą w stanie wyleczyć rany zadane przez przeszłość.

programme.title: Ostatnia szansa
programme.desc: Młody mężczyzna zostaje zwolniony z więzienia. Teraz ma szansę na zmianę swojego życia. Ale ulice się nie zmieniły. Dalej panuje na nich ta sama nienawiść, żal i strach. Właśnie to czeka na niego po drugiej stronie muru. Czy nasz bohater kiedykolwiek odzyska prawdziwą wolność?

programme.title: Kasyno w Szanghaju
programme.desc: Młoda kobieta Poppy, spragniona wrażeń w Szanghaju, trafia do kasyna Gin Sling, która zbudowała imperium hazardowe. Sir Guy Charteris kupuje teren i zmusza ją do opuszczenia lokalu przed Nowym Rokiem. Poppy zostaje wciągnięta w hazard i alkohol. Napięcia rosną, przeszłość łączy bohaterów i prowadzi do planów zemsty podczas noworocznej kolacji.

programme.title: Zemsta Lizzie Borden
programme.desc: Około 120 lat po tym, jak najsłynniejsza amerykańska morderczyni Lizzie Borden zabiła tam swoich rodziców, grupa studentek wprowadziła się do kwatery w starej posiadłości w Nowej Anglii, aby urządzić piżama party.

programme.title: Pomiędzy Światami
programme.desc: Opowieść o młodym pisarzu, który próbuje pogodzić się z dziewczyną i przetrwać zawiłości nocnego życia stolicy, korzystając jedynie z pomocy swoich imprezujących, dowcipkujących przyjaciół, którzy ciągną go od jednego londyńskiego nocnego lokalu do drugiego.

programme.title: Podli, Skończeni Oszuści
programme.desc: W mieście pełnym przestępców, jaką różnicę robi dwóch więcej? Dirty Dead Con Men (DDCM) to chłodny i niebezpieczny, neo-noir film kryminalny, który obraca się wokół zaburzonego życia dwóch nieprawdopodobnych partnerów: Mickey Rady, nieuczciwego tajnego policjanta i Kook Packard, gładkiego i charyzmatycznego oszusta.

programme.title: Krwawa Gra
programme.desc: Profesjonalny zawodnik sztuk walki Ryan McGowan (Vince Segovia) rozpoczyna współpracę z policją, by walczyć z rosnącą w mieście przestępczością i coraz to brutalniejszymi bandytami.

programme.title: Przyjaciółki, Wroginie i Fajerwerki
programme.desc: Grupa przyjaciółek spotyka się na przyjęciu sylwestrowym. Wracają dawne napięcia i dawne rywalizacje. Noc pogrąża się w chaosie, a iskry i rewelacje lecą jak fajerwerki.

programme.title: Sam
programme.desc: Sam. Nowojorski samiec alfa przemienia się w piękną dziewczynę. Zakochuje się i uczy, co to znaczy być kobietą.

programme.title: Rozmyty krąg
programme.desc: Pełnometrażowy, darmowy film w wersji z polskim lektorem - Rozmyty krąg. Film opowiada o kobiecie opłakującej stratę syna po jego zaginięciu dwa lata wcześniej. W pewnym momencie w jej życiu pojawia się tajemniczy mężczyzna z kamerą.

programme.title: Entliczek Pentliczek
programme.desc: Raul, kierowca holownika w Miami Beach, uczy się, że każdy wybór ma swoje nagrody i konsekwencje.

programme.title: CainAbel
programme.desc: W każdej rodzinie jest dobro i zło. Pokolenie, które poświęca się, by uchronić swoją rodzinę przed zniszczeniem, może przekląć i skazać na zagładę obecne i przyszłe pokolenia.

programme.title: Dom babci
programme.desc: Dom babci - Nastolatka i jej przyrodni bracia zostają zmuszeni do zamieszkania z babcią. Przekonują się, co znaczy prawdziwa miłość, wiara i rodzina. Wszystko to dzięki surowym zasadom narzucanym przez babcię i jej oddaniu. Jak każda rodzina tak i ta przeżywa swoje wzloty i upadki.

programme.title: Zabawny Derek
programme.desc: Derek staje w obronie swojej komedii, ponieważ nie może zdradzić swoich marzeń.

programme.title: Streamer
programme.desc: Odizolowany młody mężczyzna popada w obsesję na punkcie dziewczyny z kamerki internetowej, która mieszka w jego budynku. Zaprzyjaźnia się z nią, pomimo sprzecznych uczuć.

programme.title: Słodko-gorzki Poniedziałek
programme.desc: Emocjonalne pożegnanie wieloletnich najlepszych przyjaciół prowadzi do nieoczekiwanego romansu.

programme.title: Atrofia
programme.desc: Paranoja to klasyczny kryminał. Ambitny detektyw Ben (James Ray) prowadzi śledztwo w sprawie morderstwa męża najlepszej przyjaciółki swojej żony (Shane Dean).

programme.title: Osadzony
programme.desc: Weteran wojenny Ray trafia do brutalnego więzienia za obronę swojej narzeczonej. Wśród przemocy, układów i manipulacji ze strony naczelnika, walczy o przetrwanie. Jego jedynym celem jest wyjść z więzienia i wrócić do ukochanej.
Programista komputerowy staje się coraz bardziej rozczarowany podczas pracy nad projektem mającym na celu replikację ludzkiej inteligencji przy użyciu mapy ludzkiego genomu.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After Farmer Perkins murders a store clerk in front of his wife, and is allowed to walk after his trial, the Cartwright's step in to make sure he'll be rearrested, tried, and hung.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After the Virginia City bank is robbed by an outlaw gang, the gangs youngest member gets a job on the Ponderosa. Initially welcomed, Little Joe becomes suspicious of Ponderosas newest member.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: After a U.S. deputy marshal saves Adam's life from two gunmen, he explains that he is in town to bring a close friend of the Cartwright's to San Francisco to testify in a statewide racketeering trial, but the Deputy Marshal's motives for the witness soon become suspicious.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort. From 1960.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: With Tom Edwards ranch going to waste since his becoming a paraplegic following an accident with Ben, Ben makes a business proposition: The Cartwrights will build a mill on Edwards land. In return, Ben requests that he earn his investment money back as well as fifteen percent. The deal is made, but suspicions of Edwards accident bring tension to Ponderosa and put their agreement at risk.Starring Michael Landon as Joe, Dan Blocker as Hoss, Lorne Green as Ben, and Pernell Roberts as Adam. This beloved western drama ran for 14 seasons on NBC. Created by David Dortort.

programme.title: Yodelin' Kid from Pine Ridge
programme.desc: Cowboy icon Gene Autry is framed for murder in this tale of warring cattlemen and turpentiners. The music driven western from director Joseph Kane (Flame of Barbary Coast) includes such familiar faces as Smiley Burnette, Charles Middleton, and Betty Bronson. In between gunshots you'll hear plenty of traditional cowboy songs, including She'll Be Coming 'Round The Mountain, and Red River Valley, plus Gene's version of Sing Me a Song of the Saddle.

programme.title: Frontier Justice
programme.desc: Hoot Gibson is back! But he never imagined he'd find his father in an insane asylum and his cattle ranch overrun with sheep! Worst of all, Roger Williams stars as the diabolical James WIlton, a rival who isn't above murder. For trivia buffs: Director Robert F. McGowan was the man behind several of the classic Our Gang comedies...

programme.title: Young Buffalo Bill
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars in this highly fictionalized account of Bill Cody's life from director Joseph Kane (Dakota, Flame of Barbary Coast). What it lacks in accuracy is made up for with adventure, as well as and some of Roy's great cowboy songs, including 'Blow Breeze Blow', and 'Rollin' Down to Santa Fe'. Other stars include George 'Gabby' Hayes, Chief Thundercloud, and the lovely Pauline Moore (Young Mr. Lincoln, Charlie Chan at Treasure Island)

programme.title: Buffalo Stampede
programme.desc: A big time cast, including Randolph Scott, Buster Crabbe, Barton MacLane, and Harry Carey star in this feature about stampedes, Indian attacks, and plundering thieves! Directed by the esteemed Henry Hathaway (True Grit, Niagara).

programme.title: Captain Apache (Edited Version)
programme.desc: After Harry T. Collier, a beloved commissioner of Indian Affairs, is murdered in late March during the1880s, Captain Apache, an Indian graduate of West Point, is assigned by the army to investigate the crime. Suspecting that O.J., the sheriff of a town bordering the reservation may be involved in the killing, Apache travels there and finds the sheriff dining with his mistress Maude at the Paradise Saloon. Before Apache can question him, however, O.J. abruptly departs and rides out of town with Apache in pursuit. When Apache apprehends him, O.J. swears that he did not kill Collier and relates that the agents dying words were April Morning. Meanwhile, Griffin, a wealthy landowner and six of his henchmen deliver guns across the border to a corrupt Mexican general who is bent on overtaking the province by force. When Griffin then demands that the general now fulfill his part of the bargain, the general orders him killed, unaware that his lieutenant, Sanchez is in Griffins employ. Rather than killing Griffin, Sanchez shoots the general, and after promoting himself to the post, promises Griffin that he will cross the border in time for April Morning. When O.J. is found murdered, Apache questions Maude, who reveals that O.J. traveled to a Mexican cantina monthly. Apache then rides to the cantina, where he is met by a cavalry patrol led by Sgt. ORourke. Upon learning that the cantina owner has recently been killed, Apache demands that the mans widow, Rosita, take him to Rodriguez, her husbands employer. Rosita then introduces Apache to a Mexican sergeant who allegedly knows where Rodriguez can be found. Unaware that the sergeant is Rodriguez disguised as a soldier, Apache follows him to a church where the priest claims that Rodriguez has claimed sanctuary and is therefore immune to the law.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: John Wayne stars as Ted Hayden, a tough hombre who goes undercover to join a gang led by a heartless fiend known only as Mr. Gentry (Lloyd Whitlock). Gentry is out to take over a ranch belonging to one of Hayden's friends, but as Hayden finds out, Gentry has a lot more than that up his sleeve. You'll have to watch this two-fisted Western to find out the rest!

programme.title: The Legend of the Lone Ranger
programme.desc: The Butch Cavendish gang ambushes a group of Texas Rangers, killing all but one. The surviving ranger is nursed back to health by Native American Tonto, and takes on the identity of a masked vigilante, determined to bring all outlaws to justice. Culled from episodes of the popular TV series, this feature is great fun for fans of the Lone Ranger. Starring Clayton Moore and Jay Silverheels.

programme.title: Lost Canyon
programme.desc: When Johnny Travers (Jay Kirby) is falsely accused of robbing a bank, it's up to Hopalong Cassidy (William Boyd) to clear his name and find the real villains. There's nothing better than watching Hoppy get rough with the rustlers, and it's all the better when you get to hear the Sportsmen Quartette sing (I got Spurs) Jingle, Jangle, Jingle.

programme.title: The Kansan
programme.desc: Richard Dix stars in this epic of the boisterous and brawling Old West! Wounded in a gun battle with the notorious James gang, John Bonniwell (Dix) wakes up in the hospital to find out hes been elected marshal! He quickly learns that this hot-headed frontier town can only be cooled off with blazing lead and dynamite! Jane Wyatt, Albert Dekker, Victor Jory, and Robert Armstrong also star in this tale of smashing fists and crashing bullets from director George Archainbaud (The Lost Squadron).

programme.title: Bulldog Courage
programme.desc: Tim McCoy, one of the unsung heroes of 1930s western pictures, stars in a dual role. First, hes Slim Braddock, a miner who turns to robbing stagecoaches after being swindled by a banker. When Slim is murdered, his son Tim, also played by McCoy, seeks vengeance. Directed by B-movie legend Sam Newfield for Excelsior Pictures, this film is a showcase for McCoy, who appeared in more than 90 movies and in 1960 earned a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame!

programme.title: Red Ryder: Roll, Thunder, Roll!
programme.desc: Red Ryder finds two silver conchas, the trademark of bandit El Conejo, at a raided ranch. He reports the raid to Marshal Bill Faugh but tells him that he suspects that El Conejo, a Robin Hood type character, is being framed.

programme.title: Hit the Saddle
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers get involved when a local sheriff is killed in this B-western from Republic Pictures. The trouble starts when a villainous rancher (J.P. McGowan) plots to steal some government protected horses. Bob Livingstone, Max Terhune, and Ray Corrigan star as the gallant Mesquiteers, while a young Rita Hayworth (Gilda, The Lady From Shanghai) appears as a sexy saloon singer who turns a Mesquiteer's head.

programme.title: Hellgate (Edited Version)
programme.desc: In 1867 Kansas, veterinarian Sterling Hayden treats an injured stranger who turns out to have been a guerrilla raider--and Hayden soon finds himself serving a term in one of the world's most terrifying prisons under sadistic commandant Ward Bond. Adapted from the story of Dr. Mudd, the physician who attended John Wilkes Booth, assassin of President Lincoln.

programme.title: Bells of San Angelo
programme.desc: Roy Rogers and Dale Evans team up in this tale of silver mines, kidnappings, and secret passages. Roy plays a border guard who has to rescue Dale from the clutches of underhanded miner Rex Gridley (John McGuire). How does he do it? With help from Trigger, of course! With a cast that inclues Andy Devine as Sheriff Cookie Bullfincer, director William Witney gives us an enjoyable drama from the golden era of Republic Pictures!

programme.title: Home in Oklahoma
programme.desc: The entire gang is here! Roy Rogers, Dale Evans, Gabby Hayes, and Trigger are all involved in a murder mystery involving the death of a wealthy ranch owner. Songs include I Wish I Was A Kid Again and Cowboy Ham and Eggs.

programme.title: Way of the West
programme.desc: Government agent Gordon (Hal Taliaferro) goes undercover to investigate an ongoing war between cattlemen and sheepmen. But he soon finds himself framed for murder! This low budget western from the short-lived Empire Pictures is from the golden era of shoot em ups, when audiences knew who the bad guys were, and couldnt wait for the good guys to serve up some just punishment!

programme.title: Mohawk
programme.desc: Kurt Neumann (The Fly, Rocketship X-M) directed this bawdy tale of a love that was louder than war drums! With a cast that includes Scott Brady, Rita Gam, and Neville Brand, the story takes place on a remote army post where an artist romances a trio of women, just as a vengeful settler turns the army and the local Iroquois tribe against each other. Film buffs might like to know that the cinematography for this feature is by four-time Oscar nominee Karl Struss, who won an Academy Award in 1929 for his work on Sunrise.

programme.title: McLintock
programme.desc: He likes his whiskey hard... His women soft... And his west all to himself! Inspired by Shakespeares The Taming of the Shrew (1594), John Wayne (The Searchers, Stagecoach), Maureen OHara (Miracle on 34th Street, The Parent Trap), and Patrick Wayne (The Searchers, The Alamo) star in this western comedy directed by Andrew V. McLaglen (Gunsmoke, The Wild Geese). George Washington McLintock (John Wayne) is the wealthiest man in his territory who utilizes his power and influence to maintain order between farmers, ranchers, Indians, corrupt government officials, and his own family! McLintock is McNificent!

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Skull
programme.desc: The Three Mesquiteers appeared in several Republic Pictures during the 1930s, and this is considered one of their best. It's about a mysterious murder at an archeological expedition, which leads the three prairie pals into some dangerous territory. Can they solve the murder without losing their own lives? The cast includes Robert Livingston, Ray Corrigan, Max Terhune, and Roger Williams, all trying to survive a hail of poison arrows and hot lead!

programme.title: Idaho
programme.desc: Western icon Roy Rogers, along with his trusty companion Trigger, are back for another adventure. This time, a respected judge is being framed for murder by a crooked saloon owner. Always the valiant champion, Rogers vows to clear the name of the judge and find the truth all while courting a lovely beau. Cellist turned editor turned Republic Pictures workhorse Joseph Kane takes the reins of this rousing, musical adventure, which features a number of original songs performed by Rogers himself, with the help of singer-songwriter Bob Nolan and character actor Smiley Burnette (TVs Petticoat Junction).

programme.title: Brothers of the West
programme.desc: Tom Tyler plays Tom Wade, a range detective whose brother has been accused of robbery and murder. Wade has only one clue to prove his brothers innocence: a set of unusual tire tracks. This film was directed by Sam Katzman, who later became known as Jungle Sam for his association with a variety of jungle thrillers, and then as a master of all exploitation genres, from teen horror to flying saucer flicks!

programme.title: The Fighting Redhead
programme.desc: When a rustler named Faro kills one of his own henchmen and blames it on Sheila O'Conner, Red and Little Beaver set out to clear Sheila and to find evidence against Faro and his gang.

programme.title: Rawhide Rangers
programme.desc: Blackie's gang is creating havoc and the Ranger, Brand Calhoun and his brother go to investigate.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: My Pal Trigger
programme.desc: Roy Rogers goes to jail after hes wrongly accused of killing Gabby Hayes horse in this action packed yarn from Republic Pictures. All of the old jokes about cowboys kissing their horse may have started with this very movie, as it focuses on Roys loving relationship with Trigger, the greatest horse in all of Hollywood. The film also features Roys beloved Dale Evans, plus, adding some country swing to the musical numbers is Roys favorite backing band, the Sons of the Pioneers! Songs include Ole Faithful, Long, Long Ago and Livin Western Style.

programme.title: Boots and Saddles
programme.desc: When a young Englishman inherits a ranch, none other than Gene Autry takes up the challenge of turning the Brit into a real westerner. He convinces the Brit to use the ranch to raise horses, but things quickly grow complicated. Look for the usual cast of characters from Republic Pictures, including Smiley Burnette (as the irresistible Frog Millhouse!). Songs include Take Me Back To My Boots and Saddle, and Ridin the Range.

programme.title: Arizona Bound
programme.desc: The Rough Riders are called upon to help save a stagecoach line. From 1941, starring Buck Jones and Tim McCoy, plus Horace Murphy and Luana Walters. Directed by Spencer Bennett.

programme.title: Wildfire: The Story of a Horse
programme.desc: Fanning (John Miljan) has his men rustle horses and then blame it on a wild horse named Wildfire. Happy and Alkali arrive and immediately get into trouble with Fanning and his men. When Alkali is shot, Happy catches the outlaws but the Judge not only releases them, he discharges the Sheriff and tries to arrest Happy for rustling! Starring Bob Steele and Sterling Holloway, directed by Robert Emmett Tansey. 1945 (Color).

programme.title: Robin Hood of the Pecos
programme.desc: Roy Rogers finds himself elected sheriff in a wild Texas town after the Civil War. But can Roy handle a place under martial law? And can he save Gabby Hayes from being executed? And how many songs will he get to sing? Clear the burrs from your saddle and get ready for a good one, also starring Marjorie Reynolds, plus Sally Payne as Belle Starr, Queen of the Oklahoma Outlaws!

programme.title: The Hanged Man
programme.desc: After a condemned gunfighter (Steve Forrest) survives his own hanging, he helps a young widow stop a pitiless land baron from taking her ranch. This television feature boasts a strong cast of recognizable characters, including Will Geer, Sharon Acker, Dean Jagger, BarBara Luna, and Cameron Mitchell. Director Michael Caffey would go on to work on such hit shows as Barnaby Jones and MacGyver. Also, look for John Mitchum, younger brother of Robert, in a small role. This movie originally aired on ABC-TV and was considered the pilot for a possible series. Writer/producer Andrew Fenady was behind several opular TV shows such as Branded and The Rebel, as well as the 1970 John Wayne feature, Chisum.

programme.title: Tulsa
programme.desc: Susan Hayward stars in this dramatic tale of the Oklahoma oil boom. She plays Cherokee Lansing, a determined young woman out to protect her father's honor after he's killed by men from a competing oil company. With a cast that includes Robert Preston, Ed Begley, and Pedro Armendariz, this engaging picture from producer Walter Wanger (Cleopatra, I Want to Live!) was nominated for an Academy Award in the Special Effects category. Also, listen for veteran character actor Chill Wills as the narrator!

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Disaster strikes when Roy Rogers's beloved horse Trigger is stolen and held for ransom money. Will Roy find $100,000 to get his faithful companion back, or will he find a way to trap the gang holding the horse hostage? Along with Roy and Trigger, you'll find Andy Devine as Cookie Bullfincher, and young Michael Chapin as Ted Carver, a gallant boy who helps reunite Roy with the smartest horse in show business!

programme.title: Cowboy And The Prizefighter
programme.desc: Red Ryder takes Steve Stevenson, who has saved his life, to his ranch and gives him a job. Red's aunt, the Duchess, knew Steve's father, who supposedly committed suicide after losing his ranch betting on a prizefight. Steve refuses to believe that his father took his own life, suspecting he was murdered. Red and Little Beaver aid Steve in finding his father killer.

programme.title: Hell Town
programme.desc: In Hell Town (aka Born to the West) John Wayne is back in the saddle as two-fisted Dare Rudd, a roaming cowhand trying to prove he can win a woman's love and outwit a crooked saloon owner. This exciting B-movie from Paramount Pictures was based on a novel by western writer Zane Grey. With a wild and wooly cast that includes Johnny Mack Brown, Marsha Hunt, Monte Blue, and Lucian Littlefield, director Charles Barton (Abbott and Costello Meet Frankenstein) gives us a tale of romance, action, and high stakes gambling!

programme.title: In Old Colorado
programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy and his crew get involved in a war over water rights in this feature from Harry Sherman Productions and Paramount Pictures. The intrigue starts when crafty Joe Weller (Morris Ankrum) turns two ranchers against each other, which leads to dire results. This is the 33rd of 66 Hopalong Cassidy movies, with WIlliam Boyd in the role he made famous. Also, look for regular Hoppy co-stars Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Andy Clyde as California Carson.

programme.title: Hoppy Serves a Writ
programme.desc: Sheriff Hopalong Cassidy triumphs again in this lighthearted western romp from Harry Sherman Productions. Good ol' Hoppy (William Boyd) has to leave his beloved Texas to track down some bad guys in Oklahoma. You can bet that the action and suspense will follow Hopalong wherever he goes. Also, look for a number of familiar faces in the ast, including TV's future Superman George Reeves, notorious Hollywood heavy Victor Jory, and in his first credited role, Robert Mitchum! In fact, Mitchum would appear in more of Hoppy's adventures before branching out on his own and becoming one of Hollywood's greatest stars. Also featuring Jan Christy, Forbes Murray, Byron Foulger, Earle Hodgins, and Roy Barcroft. Directed by Goerge Archainbaud.

programme.title: Daredevil
programme.desc: Matt Murdock egzystuje w świecie wiecznej ciemności, jednak przenikająca go czerń jest wypełniona dźwiękami, zapachami, smakami i teksturami, których inni nie są w stanie odczuć.

programme.title: Krew i Forsa
programme.desc: Emerytowany weteran wojskowy Jim Reed wiedzie spokojny żywot w północnym Maine. Jego pasją są polowania. Podczas jednego z nich natrafia na martwą kobietę i dużą sumę pieniędzy. To początek niezwykle groźnej rozgrywki, przez którą Jim będzie musiał wrócić do swojej dawnej profesji.

programme.title: Syndykat Zabójców
programme.desc: Kiedy matka - głowa rodziny płatnych zabójców, dowiaduje się o ciężkiej chorobie, rozpoczyna się walka o przejęcie władzy i całego imperium tworzonego przez długie lata.

programme.title: Głos Violet
programme.desc: Oparta na popularnej powieści produkcja opowiada losy Shawna, chłopaka ze spektrum autyzmu, który spotyka na swojej drodze przebojową Violet i myśli, że dziewczyna jest jego idealną, bratnią duszą a nawet przyszłą żoną.

programme.title: Smarfton
programme.desc: Wynne, która cierpi na zespół stresu pourazowego po śmierci narzeczonego, zaczyna widzieć na swoim smartfonie niepokojące obrazy dotyczące swojej przyszłości. Jeśli nie uda się jej rozwikłać mrocznej tajemnicy - umrze.

programme.title: Wszyscy na pokład!
programme.desc: Sześcioro dzieci, dwoje dorosłych i ekscytująca ośmiogodzinna wakacyjna podróż koleją.

programme.title: Dawno temu w Ameryce
programme.desc: Pełen przemocy i pasji film gangsterski o losach czterech przyjaciół z dzieciństwa, które spędzili w dawnej żydowskiej dzielnicy Nowego Jorku. Jako dorośli zostali znanymi gangsterami, współtworzącymi przestępcze imperium ery prohibicji.

programme.title: Drzwi do przyszłości
programme.desc: Przenosimy się do dystopijnej przyszłości, w której technologia teleportacji pozwala dwóm bohaterkom uciec przed ludobójstwem. W wyniku wybrania złego teleportu zostają rozdzielone.

programme.title: 24 godziny
programme.desc: 24 godziny, które na zawsze mogą zmienić życie trójki bohaterów. Przejmujący wyścig z czasem w obliczu kryzysu ekonomicznego w Hiszpanii. Siła przyjaźni i solidarności, które pozwalają przetrwać najtrudniejsze momenty w życiu.

programme.title: Cerebrum
programme.desc: Po przebudzeniu się z trwającej ponad rok śpiączki, niepewny siebie młody mężczyzna stopniowo odkrywa jak wiele zmieniło się w jego życiu i jakie konsekwencje mają dzisiaj czyny, które popełnił w przeszłości.

programme.title: Do diabła z miłością
programme.desc: Gdy niepoprawny kobieciarz i bawidamek, dziennikarz piszący do czasopisma dla mężczyzn spotyka autorkę o feministycznych poglądach i własnych tajemnych planach, rozpoczyna się klasyczne starcie płci, zmierzające nieuchronnie do szczęśliwego finału.

programme.title: Czas zapłaty
programme.desc: Twórca komiksów pracujący w klubie burleski prosi swojego przyjaciela o pomoc w odkryciu, co kryje się za zniknięciami młodych kobiet, które mają miejsce w okolicy od kilku miesięcy. Trafią na trop, prowadzący ich do bardzo niebezpiecznych ludzi.

programme.title: Niepoczytalna
programme.desc: Młoda kobieta opuszcza swoje rodzinne miasto, aby uciec przed niespokojną przeszłością i rozpocząć nową pracę. Kiedy mimowolnie oddaje się instytucji psychiatrycznej, staje przed największym strachem - ale czy to prawda, czy tylko złudzenie?

programme.title: Agent XXL: Rodzinny interes
programme.desc: Malcolm Turner oraz jego nastoletni pasierb Trent w przebraniu kobiet badają sprawę morderstwa w szkole artystycznej dla dziewcząt.

programme.title: Gotowi do walki
programme.desc: Akcja rozgrywa się podczas II Wojny Światowej. Specjalny oddział żołnierzy armii amerykańskiej zostaje wysłany na misję prowadzoną w niezwykle niebezpiecznej okolicy, aby odnaleźć zaginionego dowódcę.

programme.title: Połączeni
programme.desc: Film porusza temat współczesnego kryzysu opioidowego w Ameryce i zadaje pytanie, jak do tego doszło - z trzech różnych punktów widzenia. Prezesa firmy farmaceutycznej, lekarza oraz pacjenta.

programme.title: Meet the Spartans
programme.desc: Meet The Spartans, film twórców „Komedii romantycznej”, jest komiczną parodią epickiego filmu spod znaku miecza i sandałów.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Szukając sposobu na uratowanie swojego skazanego na zagładę świata, załoga maleńkich, wyglądających jak ludzie kosmitów przybywa na Ziemię w idealnym przebraniu - statku kosmicznym w kształcie zwykłego człowieka.

programme.title: Wrogie siły
programme.desc: Emerytowany żołnierz Mickey zabiera rodzinę na miłe spokojne wakacje. Przypadkiem znajdą tam coś, co nie powinno znaleźć się w ich posiadaniu. Nagle ich życie znajdzie sie w śmiertelnym niebezpieczeństwie.

programme.title: Niewierna
programme.desc: Żona i matka w średnim wieku ma romans z przystojnym, młodszym mężczyzną. Kiedy jej mąż dowiaduje się o romansie, zabija on mężczyznę, a dwoje małżonków musi przemyśleć to, co się wydarzyło.

programme.title: Zakręcony
programme.desc: Elliot Richards to nieszczęśliwy młody mężczyzna dręczony nieodwzajemnioną miłością, który desperacko pragnie odmienić swój los, więc zawiera pakt z Diabłem, który mu to sprytnie obiecuje, co ma swoją cenę.

programme.title: Birdman
programme.desc: Riggan Thomson (Michael Keaton) postanawia wystawić na Broadwayu sztukę. Ma nadzieję, że to pomoże mu wskrzesić karierę, którą zbudował na roli kinowego superbohatera.

programme.title: Butter
programme.desc: Gdy otyły chłopak ogłasza swoje niezwykłe i niebezpieczne wyzwanie, które chce zaprezentować w internecie, staje się coraz bardziej popularny wśród swoich rówieśników. Czy jednak to jest najlepszy sposób na zwrócenie uwagi kolegów i koleżanek?

programme.title: Bez Ściemy
programme.desc: Ekipa filmowa podąża za politycznym specem od Public Relations Rickiem Klingmanem, który właśnie otrzymał niezwykle trudne zadanie. Ma pomóc jednemu z kandydatów do Kongresu w kampanii wyborczej do Kongresu, a przede wszystkim znaleźć haki na jego rywala.

programme.title: Big Momma's House 2
programme.desc: Agent FBI przebiera się za starszą panią i jako niania śledzi podejrzanego.

programme.title: Bitwa o Ardeny
programme.desc: Rozpoczęła się bitwa o Ardeny. Porucznik Cappa i jego ludzie z 2-giej Dywizji Piechoty muszą znaleźć sposób na powstrzymanie niemieckiej inwazji wszelkimi możliwymi środkami. Podczas starcia przyjaciele nie są tym, kim się wydają, a wrogowie są wszędzie.

programme.title: Wyspa Bergmana
programme.desc: Para amerykańskich filmowców Chris (Vicky Krieps ) i Tony (Tim Roth) przyjeżdża latem na mityczną wyspę Fårö. W tym niezwykłym miejscu, w którym żył i tworzył swoje najbardziej znane dzieła Bergman, mają nadzieję znaleźć inspirację do nowych filmów.

programme.title: Milion Dni
programme.desc: W ciagu jednej nocy astronauta musi zdecydować, czy kontynuować dzieło swojego życia, czy porzucić je dla znacznie ważniejszego celu.

programme.title: Niewierna
programme.desc: Sara i Jean od kilku lat są w szczęśliwym związku. Pewnego dnia Sara przypadkowo spotyka na ulicy François, swojego dawnego partnera i przyjaciela Jeana. Wkrótce potem François proponuje Jeanowi wspólną pracę, a sytuacja między nimi zaczyna wymykać się spod kontroli.

programme.title: Life or Something Like It
programme.desc: Po przeprowadzeniu wywiadu z bezdomnym jasnowidzem, który mówi jej, że jej życie nie ma sensu i za kilka dni się skończy, reporterka postanawia zmienić swoje postępowanie.

programme.title: Zasady nie obowiązują
programme.desc: Aspitująca młoda aktorka (Lily Collins) oraz jej ambitny młody kierowca (Alden Ehrenreich) zmagają się z absurdalnymi dziwactwami nieprzewidywalnego miliardera Howarda Hughesa (Warren Beatty), dla którego pracują.

programme.title: Spowiedź Mściciela
programme.desc: Jeden kościół, jeden ksiądz, ranny mężczyzna z naładowaną bronią. Intensywny thriller rozgrywający się w czasie rzeczywistym, jednej nocy, podczas której mściciel wyzna wszystkie swoje grzechy z przeszłości i będzie chciał rozliczyć się z tymi, którzy go zdradzili.

programme.title: Obcy na poddaszu
programme.desc: Komedia przygodowa o grupie dzieci podczas rodzinnych wakacji, które muszą odeprzeć atak sięgających im do kolan obcych przybyszy, którzy przybywają na ziemię z zamiarem zniszczenia naszej planety.
